name: @chestor/graph-ui
title: Graph
description: Renderer web component for the Chestor graph workspace kind — nested semantic graph canvas.

wippy.description: Renders an interactive semantic graph canvas as <chestor-graph>. Pass entry-id with the graph workspace component id; mode may be preview (the default, read-focused canvas) or full (structure tree, editing controls, schema editor, inspector, undo/redo, and layout tools). The component fetches and mutates its graph through the authenticated workspace graph API, listens for projection updates, and does not consume slotted content.

entry-id.description: Workspace graph component id to load; an empty value renders the required-id error state.

mode.description: Rendering mode: preview for the compact read-focused canvas, or full for editing and navigation controls.

read-only.description: Keeps the full reading surface available and disables changes for a shared reader.
